title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-21
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CDA > DAW(Bertha) > CDA/SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a legendary ’69 Boston show, featuring a blistering Dark Star/St Stephen/The Eleven/Love Light suite and a standout Viola Lee Blues.
ai_review.review: The tape captures one of the Dead’s peak‑year performances – a raw yet tight first set that builds into an unforgettable second set highlighted by a monster Dark Star > St Stephen > The Eleven > Turn On Your Lovelight sequence, a scorching Viola Lee Blues and a funky Foxy Lady jam.  The soundboard mix is crystal‑clear with superb balance (though there’s a faint hiss, occasional reel cut‑offs and a few minutes missing from the Foxy Lady jam).  Overall both the music and the audio quality earn high marks.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (≈90%) rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising both performance and sound; only a handful note minor flaws.  This consistent enthusiasm yields a strong positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix with superb instrument separation; slight tape hiss and occasional cut‑outs at the reel’s end; ~3‑4 min of the Foxy Lady jam missing.

standout_songs: Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven > Turn On Your Lovelight
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is a bit rough but gains momentum; second set erupts into a classic sequence with an extended Dark Star, tight transitions and high‑energy jams that keep the show soaring.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone described as rich, fuzzy and ‘perfect’; shredding runs on Viola Lee Blues, inventive slide work on Hard To Handle, and stellar improvisation throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass praised as huge, bezerker‑mode on The Eleven, and a prominent presence in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s (T.C.) contributions noted for adding texture; no specific praise/critique beyond that.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart described as solid, grooving duo with excellent duet work and powerful support on jams.
